title: Sam Henry and the public houses of the district
summary: Amacker describes Sam Henry as an old Ravage Street player and the sporting houses lining the streets, with prices and some of the sex shows he took part in.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Well say a guy like Sam Henry, where was he from?

He's from here, right from here. Sam Henry, he's from here. Old time player, old Ravage Street player, years ago. In those days, a neighborhood like this, like you see this neighborhood. Both sides of these streets here, both sides of these streets here would be what you call public houses. See, in those days. As the men passed by, hello, come here, come here, come here, come here, come here, let me tell you something. Let me tell you something. You're passionate. Don't you want this, don't you want that one? Up on 2nd Street, huh? No, no, no. Down on the Gravy Street, down the rail like this, all on Gravy. From Gravy Street on downtown. Gasket Street? Yeah, Gasket Street there. Gasket Street. Come here, take me something as you pass by. Come here, take me something.
Do you want to buy something, buy something, so-and-so, buy something, so-and-so.
It cost you 50 cents. Took a long time for it went up to the dollar. The church was too big 50 cents that day.
The church was too big 50 cents. Yeah. Times would change, though, the church ain't walking no more.

Sometimes, I used to make money like this. Sometimes, freaks come into place, and a pair of holding them, and let me screw right in their presence. And you sit right by the bed like this, see? And we're in bed there. And then as I school you, play with yourself, see? And when I come you do too. Oh, they got all kinds. I got all kinds. Oh, I got all kinds. Used to be a fellow come down there.
Some years ago, used to pass the whip his ass. I drug. I get a bull.
